1. Community Respect:
Users must respect all other participants. Any form of harassment, hate speech, or abuse will result in an immediate and permanent ban.

2. Content Policy:
Sexual content, nudity, or inappropriate behavior during calls is strictly prohibited.

3. Privacy:
We do not record your calls. However, your registration data (Email, Name, Gender) is used to provide the service and is stored securely on our cloud server.

4. Reporting:
You can report any user for violating these terms. Our moderators will review and take action within 24 hours.

5. Prohibited Actions:
Screen recording or capturing private conversations without consent is not allowed.

By using TINKL - SpeakwithAI, you agree to follow these guidelines to maintain a healthy learning environment.
